note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "At 115gr this Power Hammer™ is a fantastic weight for any of the 6.5mm cartridges. This bullet weight will produce very good velocity yet still have plenty of bullet for most any big game. This pure copper bullet is very attractive in the 6.5 Creedmoor at about 3100 fps as well as about 3600 fps in a 6.5 PRC."
